## Triage: first-touch audit · p1 · `domain:server` · `pm:queue` · 2026-11-05T02:55Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. An organization's require-MFA can be turned on while two-factor is off (`features.twoFactor: false`). After the grace period, every member, the owner included, is sent to a two-factor setup that cannot be completed, and nobody can recover from inside the product. A whole-tenant lockout from one Setup toggle, so p1.
- Fix site: `plugin-auth`, refusing the save (or the enforcement) while two-factor is off. The Setup wording is the `domain:ui` half.

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Claim correction (supersedes the Clause-② line and widens the file surface of claim 6648643507; every other line stands)
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured by the dev: route (a) cannot hold (the twoFactor switch is process configuration; an org row turning it on survives neither a restart nor another node), so route (b): an organization write of `require_mfa = true` while two-factor is off is refused (400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`), a value an admin could save before. Plus the gate fail-safe: with two-factor off the MFA gate neither blocks nor stamps `mfa_required_at`, so rows already stored `true` lock no one out. Changeset carries the BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 marker. Review owed: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` over the non-prose diff (narrowing face).
File surface (added): `packages/verify/src/held-session-impersonation-target.pin.test.ts`, `packages/verify/src/held-session-vendor-admin-doors.pin.test.ts` (one config key `plugins.twoFactor: true` each, so the held-session pins still exercise an enforcing gate after the fail-safe). Accepted by the seat, subject to the contract review.
